brand.name: PEAK
brand.name_note: Display name in all new copy and labels is 'PEAK' -- never 'Peak Saunas', never 'PEAK SAUNAS'. Domain, email, URL/product handles and the legal entity line (Peak Wellness USA LLC) are unchanged.
color.role.primary_dark: basalt -- text on light, dark grounds, default logo on light
color.role.primary_light: stone -- primary light ground, text/logo on dark
color.role.editorial: red -- editorial colour blocks, headline panels
color.role.accent: solar-flare -- CTAs and highlights, sparingly (one accent element per view)
color.role.forbidden: no green (#16C47F is retired), no cyan, gold, purple or navy; no gradients, glows or drop shadows
color.text.muted_note: Basalt mixed 28% toward Stone. 6.17:1 on Stone, 4.57:1 on Fossil Dust -- both pass AA 4.5 for body text.
color.button.accent_text_note: NEVER light or white text on Solar Flare (2.92:1). Basalt on Solar Flare is 6.03:1.
color.button.secondary: transparent fill, 1px Basalt outline, Basalt text
font.main.license_status: Acid Grotesk license pending; fallback in use
font.main.note: The toolbox carries a TRIAL build only, which must not be used. Nothing is self-hosted for this face; the fallback stack renders instead.
font.main.usage: headlines UPPERCASE; labels/eyebrows UPPERCASE 12px letter-spacing 0.08em; body sentence case
font.secondary.license_status: licensed (Superior Type webfont EULA, in the Drive Fonts folder)
font.secondary.usage: paragraph titles, editorial moments, sentence case
font.weights: one weight only -- no bold, no italics for emphasis; use scale, case and placement instead
shape.radius_note: 4px on boxes on every page type -- owner decision 2026-09-22. --ps-radius-box is the one token every box (cards, buttons, badges, image frames/tiles) resolves through; --ps-radius-card/-btn/-pill/-round stay 0 (pills and fully-round shapes are still unused, still square).
shape.card: Fossil Dust fill, no shadow, 4px radius; or 1px Basalt outline on Stone
logo.rule: Basalt logo on light grounds, Stone logo on dark grounds. Never a Stone or White logo on Solar Flare.
logo.clear_space: the height of the A's chevron cap
logo.never: never redraw the wordmark and never set 'PEAK' in a font -- use the toolbox files only
logo.legacy: no legacy logo.png was ever committed under brand/ -- the old mark was referenced by URL only (see tokens-legacy.json's logo.url), so there was nothing to rename
layout.voice: generous negative space, few elements, flat colour blocks, wide margins; text column left / visual right
